quotations.old_english: Crist ðone wácan assan geceás him to byrþre
quotations.english: Christ chose the mean ass for his bearer

quotations.old_english: Ða byrþeras hine to byrgenne féredon
quotations.english: the bearers bare him to the grave

quotations.old_english: Seó untrumnys his gecyndes behófode sumes byrþres
quotations.english: the infirmity of his nature had need of some supporter

source_text: byrþere; gen. byrþres; m. [beran to bear, carry] A bearer, carrier, supporter; portarius, vespillo, fulcimen :-- Crist ðone wácan assan geceás him to byrþre Christ chose the mean ass for his bearer, Homl. Th. i. 210, 16. Ða byrþeras hine to byrgenne féredon the bearers bare him to the grave, i. 492, 27. Seó untrumnys his gecyndes behófode sumes byrþres the infirmity of his nature had need of some supporter, i. 308, 12.
